This transaction is not a sale of shares by the Reporting Person. Instead, this represents shares that have been withheld by the Issuer to satisfy its income tax and withholding and remittance obligations in connection with the vesting and net settlement of previously reported Restricted Stock Units ("RSUs"). || Certain of these securities are represented by RSUs and performance-based restricted stock units ("PSUs").

The Reporting Person has elected to receive fully vested shares of the Issuer's common stock in lieu of the Reporting Person's annual cash retainer for services on the Issuer's Board of Directors, which is payable quarterly. The number of shares issued represents the quotient of (A) the amount of such fees for the first, second and third quarters divided by (B) the Issuer's closing stock price on the date such fees should have been paid, rounded down to the nearest whole share.
